method: Actual screenshots of the running in-app browser at a target of 8 frames/s. Actual capture intervals retained; edited cuts remove preparation gaps. No generated frames or audio.
encoding_padding: One black pixel column added for even-width H.264 encoding.

sections.name: 01-dynamics
sections.title: Run the sampled PID axis; change mass from 1 to 2 kg and target from 1 to 0.5 m.

sections.name: 02-control-plots
sections.title: Inspect continuous-time root locus, Bode and Nyquist views; toggle Nyquist zoom.

sections.name: 03-robot-3d
sections.title: Run the kinematic arm demonstration; zoom and watch tool coordinates.

sections.name: 10-builder-port-drag
sections.title: Prepared model: Constant 3, Gain 2, Scope. Drag each OUT circle onto the next IN circle.

sections.name: 11-builder-live-scope

scope: Recorded software behavior, not hardware validation.
